Thought: To determine the best detector for separating multiple different sugars in fluid chromatography, consider the properties of sugars and how each detector works. Sugars typically do not have strong UV absorption, making UV-Vis detectors less effective. Fluorescence detectors are also not ideal for sugars unless they are derivatized to be fluorescent. Refractive Index (RI) detectors are commonly used for detecting sugars because they measure changes in the refractive index as the sample elutes, making them suitable for molecules like sugars that lack chromophores.
